product_scope: Human-supervised local coding workspace on native Apple Silicon macOS 26/27 with at least 48 GiB unified memory

installed_runtime.machine: Apple M4 Max, 48 GiB unified memory
installed_runtime.power: Coding Task02 sampled both AC and battery; final public-install diagnostics sampled AC. Power was not recorded for every Task12 stage.

coding_edit_test.result: Agent read before editing; frozen Task02 grader 2/2 and independent noncanonical/exclusive-end checks passed. Imported-code checks ran, and the saved-session follow-up inspected the current diff. No operator code correction was needed.

browser_search.result: Native Browse exercised a visible success and duplicate-ID error in the disposable app; Search returned and opened current official OpenCode documentation. Both MCP servers were connected in deep diagnostics. Independent 390x844 and 1280x800 browser views passed without page errors.

unsupported_claims.result: An intentionally failing check exited 7 in three bounded controller rounds; the controller remained blocked and accepted=false despite model completion. The driver marked the negative test incomplete as expected. This does not establish general autonomous coding success.

compaction_restart.result: Three real OpenCode compactions and fresh server/client processes continued one saved project. Checkpoint evidence preserved the goal, failed checks and unverified status; the third checkpoint flagged files changed since the prior checkpoint. Current checks and operator review followed. An earlier handoff made inaccurate source claims and was not treated as acceptance.

resource_safety.result: The unchanged daily-use guard recorded warning pressure [1,2] during one continuation, allowed work, saw zero swap growth and no abort; other final-wheel stages sampled normal pressure. Exact-wheel regressions exercise critical pressure, missing telemetry, swap and listener-change refusal. The saved project resumed after guarded startup and rollback. No unsafe critical pressure was induced on the owner Mac, so a live critical-stop event is not claimed.

sustained_supervised_use.active_accounting: 2381.817 seconds in disjoint native user-prompt spans plus 505.562 seconds of task-specific interstage operator checks and corrections; unrelated 590.419-second gap, idle, preflight and teardown excluded.
sustained_supervised_use.result: After two failed Agent UI attempts, the operator corrected the disposable project. Frozen backend 2/2, real-server unit tests 5/5, independent browser 11/11 and encoded-ID/filter holdouts passed. The fresh local Reviewer made inaccurate low-severity findings and was advisory only. One failed regression attempt was operator-interrupted and counted as active failed work.

terminal_gui_controls.result: Exact-wheel terminal splash, Ask/Plan/Agent, Default/Fast, native model picker, persisted Ask/Auto permissions and explicit Ask lock worked. Authenticated GUI rendered; its native permission toggle persisted off/on/off across reload. In an existing project, GUI model picker showed local Qwen plus optional OpenCode models, and effort changed Default/Fast/Default. A saved session pointing to a deleted temporary project returned provider API 500 and an empty picker; opening an extant project restored controls.

final_artifact_lifecycle.result: Clean-main wheel and installer hashes verified. Exact wheel installed, rolled back, reactivated, uninstalled and reactivated with sessions/models retained. Saved OpenCode session reopened after restart. Anonymous HTTPS assets matched the qualified hashes. Public installer activated the owner from its public package store; public rollback and reactivation passed. Fresh public-launcher startup and doctor --deep passed with healthy 96K runtime and zero swap. Separate macOS-account installation was waived by the owner.

offline_and_supply_chain.result: Final source make check passed 212 Python and 85 Node tests, native-trial and frozen-suite self-checks, documentation links and git diff hygiene. Outside-checkout package smoke rebuilt the same wheel hash. Wheel manifest contains 23 curated payload files and no evaluation runs. Pinned browser npm production lock audit reported zero advisories. Redacted Git-history gitleaks scan found 11 generic-api-key matches, all inspected as 64-character hexadecimal artifact hashes in historical manifests/receipts.

research_only_failures: Autonomous Task12 acceptance did not become repeatable.
Fresh local Reviewer accuracy is insufficient for acceptance authority.
Useful reasoning throughout the full configured 96K context is not established.
No matched frontier-model comparison exists under the local/free-only constraint.
raw_evidence: Ignored evals/runs/v1-final2-coding-20261002-01, evals/runs/v1-final-sustained-20261002-01 and evals/runs/v1-final-claim-20261002-01 are retained on the owner's qualification Mac; user data and raw transcripts are not published.
